arrival_delivery_ratio.name: arrival_delivery_ratio
arrival_delivery_ratio.rule: gi_reference.delivery_ratio_band (0.6-1.0, at or below adequacy: cool extremities, CRT 3 s, mildly impaired perfusion, lactate 3.1) read under the extraction reserve as ratio / reserve (P2I-2P), as every GI package does

arrival_lactate_excess.name: arrival_lactate_excess
arrival_lactate_excess.rule: gi_reference.lactate_excess_band's rule: the arrival lactate less a non-shock clearance baseline of 0.8-2.0 mmol/L; the baseline is not stated

arrival_oxygen_debt.name: arrival_oxygen_debt
arrival_oxygen_debt.rule: gi_reference.arrival_debt_band's scale (0-60 index-minutes, the same for every case): a latent arrival-state variable, never computed from the arrival lactate; the authored onset (60 min) does not set it (no history is reconstructed)

intrinsic_sinus_rate.name: intrinsic_sinus_rate
intrinsic_sinus_rate.rule: gi_reference.intrinsic_hr_band's rule: the resting adult sinus rate, at most the observed HR; no beta-blocker or rate control is authored (metformin, losartan, statin)

pump_reserve.name: pump_reserve
pump_reserve.rule: the case shows reduced reserve (globally mildly reduced LV contraction, bibasal B-lines, mild congestion on the radiograph, basal crackles, troponin 260): below the GI band's 0.7-1.0, which had no such evidence; the value is not stated: faculty decision

truth.cardiac_exam: Regular tachycardia; no new murmur; extremities are cool.
truth.chest_xray: Mild pulmonary congestion without focal consolidation.
truth.diagnosis: Left main or severe three-vessel ischemia with diffuse ST depression and ST elevation in aVR
truth.pocus_lungs: Scattered B-lines at both bases; no diffuse B-line pattern
truth.pocus_lv: Globally mildly reduced contraction without a single focal defect
truth.respiratory_exam: Mildly increased effort; scattered basal crackles.

faculty.authorized: arrival mapping; ischaemic pump writer; reperfusion writer; congestion / L writer; observation layer; case intrinsic sinus rate; family arrival latent mapping

deferred.respiratory: EXPECTED_RESPIRATORY_FAMILY_EXTENSION (L -> gas exchange, oxygenation, congestion drive, NIV)

faculty.hr: the common HR physiology only (intrinsic rate as a case mapping); no ACS sympathetic gain or HR residual
faculty.not_authorized: common-core retuning; GI changes; runtime; collapse activation or thresholds; ROSC / ACLS; NIV; common L -> G / SpO2; pressure -> tone baroreflex; P-dependent afterload; full ACS rollout; a third family
faculty.objective: acs_70f_left_main through the existing common physiology without retuning the GI core; shadow only
faculty.pump: the common P channel; no second pump equation; LV impairment kept through the arrival layer

design.migration_gate: MIGRATION_GATE_CLOSED: no runtime hook, collapse activation, clinical collapse threshold, ROSC / ACLS, NIV, common L -> G / SpO2, baroreflex -> tone, P-dependent afterload, full ACS rollout or third family.

observation_layer.b_lines_congestion: an observation of L: the authored bibasal B-lines and mild congestion are the arrival reading (L = 0 is arrival); L above 0 reads more congestion
observation_layer.ecg_ischaemia: a family observation (diffuse ST depression with aVR elevation while the artery is occluded); no common channel
observation_layer.lv_function: an observation of P: the authored 'globally mildly reduced contraction' is the arrival reading (P = 1 with the reduced reserve and delivery the arrival layer declares); a fall of P from arrival reads worse, a recovery toward 1 reads back to the authored finding
observation_layer.rhythm: R (sinus, its rate from the common HR physiology)
observation_layer.troponin: a family observation (the legacy curve is LEGACY_REFERENCE_ONLY); no common channel

design.policy: Shadow only: no common file changes; the case mapping and the family writers are declared, never approved; the common profile is one predeclared point of the GI-carried uncertainty; no legacy output is a target; collapse is read structurally and never acts; nothing reaches runtime.
design.recommendation_rule: Predeclared. With READY: IMPLEMENT_EXPECTED_RESPIRATORY_EXTENSION when the case's authored congestion has no downstream path in the core (L rises with no SpO2 / G change) and the legacy comparison carries a respiratory EXPECTED_EXTENSION; otherwise PROCEED_TO_CARDIOGENIC_CASE_EXPANSION; TEST_THIRD_MECHANISTIC_FAMILY only if both the respiratory extension and case expansion are found unnecessary.
design.verdict_rule: Predeclared. READY iff every criterion holds; otherwise NOT_READY - the first failing criterion.

classes.hr_arrival: LEGACY_DIFFERENCE_NOT_CLINICALLY_RELEVANT: the legacy shows the authored HR; the core's is the common HR physiology's at the midpoint intrinsic rate (reported, not absorbed)
classes.sbp_course: LEGACY_DIFFERENCE_NOT_CLINICALLY_RELEVANT: both fall under untreated ischaemia; the size is the family candidate's and the legacy drift's, neither authored
classes.spo2_course: EXPECTED_EXTENSION_NOT_YET_MODELED: the legacy SpO2 falls with congestion; the core's L has no gas-exchange path (EXPECTED_RESPIRATORY_FAMILY_EXTENSION)
classes.vf_120: EXPECTED_EXTENSION_NOT_YET_MODELED: LEGACY_FAMILY_EVENT_DEFERRED (no scripted VF, no ROSC / ACLS)

migration_gate: MIGRATION_GATE_CLOSED: no runtime hook, collapse activation, clinical collapse threshold, ROSC / ACLS, NIV, common L -> G / SpO2, baroreflex -> tone, P-dependent afterload, full ACS rollout or third family.

pump.absolute_impairment: the arrival layer: arrival_delivery_ratio (DO2 index against normal, derived.effective_delivery) and pump_reserve; never multiplied into output again
pump.output: output_rel = P x rhythm share x preload response (on the current pump's curve, relative to arrival filling) x afterload (derived._perfusion)
pump.pending_common_decision: a depressed pump without added volume does not congest through the common coupling (derived.congestion_rate's own note): the family congestion writer carries the cardiogenic part
pump.preload: the curve's scale is preload_curve_scale_ml x P^c (derived.preload_position): a falling P lowers the plateau and the gain per mL
pump.reserve: pump_reserve enters only the congestion shortfall 1 - reserve x P (derived.congestion_rate)

verdict.rule: Predeclared. READY iff every criterion holds; otherwise NOT_READY - the first failing criterion.
